ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 55:45 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels. High-intensity pixels are localized on the distal lateral sections of both lobes, while low-intensity pixels form a contiguous central mass extending from the notch to the lower fluke boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) contiguous zones are mapped to the outer 30% of each fluke lobe. These zones contain high-frequency low-intensity (black) mottling. A central low-intensity black zone occupies the medial 40% of the visible surface, narrowing toward the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central U-shaped depression with a wide internal pixel-angle and a depth approximately 1/8th of the total vertical fluke height visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the distal trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys. The most prominent serrations are located on the left lobe tip and right lobe tip, showing jagged, multi-pixel protrusions against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature on the distal edges, transitioning to a convex curve toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular, ring-shaped high-contrast clusters (white outlines on black background and black outlines on white background) scattered across both lobes, with higher density in the transitional pigmentation zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, near-vertical high-intensity linear marks are detected in the central black region, specifically near the lower boundary where the fluke meets the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense circular scarring (likely barnacle attachment sites) across the entire visible surface; the extreme tips of both the left and right lobes show irregular, jagged physical edges suggesting prior minor trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentration of circular 'donut' scars in the lower-central region of the left lobe forming a dense, overlapping cluster.
